required_checks.rationale: Both release gates bind the Tests check to canonical CI push runs for the exact main commit; no CI job publishes production artifacts.

This protected workflow is a PR-admission gate and cannot be given a push trigger by an ordinary change. The publication gate resolves the unique merged pull request associated with the product commit, requires that pull request to target main, binds its head SHA to the product commit's second parent, and then requires every canonical pull_request_target run of this workflow at that PR head to succeed. A direct push has no associated pull request and therefore does not publish.
